newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian sees quarterly profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Canadian sees quarterly profit in 1998.

text.p: Canadian Airlines Corp said Wednesday that it expects to be profitable on a "rolling quarterly basis" by the second quarter of 1998.
"We're trying on a rolling basis to make the company profitable," Canadian president Kevin Benson told the airline's annual meeting.
Company said the company's four-year restructuring plan announced in November was on track and should show meaningful improvements year over year.
Canadian posted a C$1.56 a share loss for the first quarter compared to a C$2.56 a share loss for the same period of last year.

Benson said Canadian will not purchase new aircraft to expand service on its Asian routes until the airline becomes profitable. Improved results should generate renewed interest from investors and provide additional equity for the company, he said.
"By a year from now we hope we would have a number of groups interested in the stock," Benson said.
